name: Sparse Latent Space for 4D Novel View Synthesis (SLS4D)
definition: A method for 4D novel-view synthesis that uses a learnable sparse latent space to represent radiance fields, reducing network parameters compared to dense grid discretizations while maintaining high-frequency detail via attention-based interpolation.
summary: SLS4D is a 4D novel-view synthesis method using a sparse latent space and attention-based interpolation to reduce parameters while maintaining high-frequency detail and temporal continuity.
